summary: Positive-dimensional intersections of distinct irreducible components obstruct geometric envelopes in every characteristic.
detailedSummary: Actual conductor separators and G331's normal divisorial bound produce a strictly negative continuous signed primary-model obstacle with no greatest C/D minorant. All-support divisorial density proves the USC contradiction. The theorem needs a cross-component normalization fibre; it assumes neither source CE nor higher-dimensional resolution.
text:
Let R be any excellent reduced positive-dimensional local ring, a a primary gauge, S its finite normalization, rho its FULL boundary quotient and c its conductor. Suppose one rho-fibre has lifts alpha,beta on normal centres belonging to DIFFERENT minimal components. Then a bounded strictly negative continuous SIGNED PRIMARY-MODEL obstacle on R has neither a greatest geometric C nor a greatest geometric D minorant.

Choose a regular conductor element c0. Normalization idempotents e1,e2 for the distinct domain factors give actual downstairs elements j=c0e1 and ell=c0e2, since c is an S-ideal. They vanish on all other components and are nonzero on their own. The nontrivial fibre is conductor-infinite by G331, so alpha,beta kill c0.

Choose a centred divisorial valuation nu on the normal local centre containing beta, normalized by aS. G331's normal-domain bound gives finite K>=1 with nu(I)<=K beta(I) for every primary/unit ideal there. Specifically nu(h)<=C ord_m(h) for nonunits and beta(m)>=1/r when m^r subset aS give this inequality; units are handled separately. Negative finite REAL combinations satisfy u(nu)>=K u(beta). Uniform comparison and ACTUAL decreasing infima extend it to ENTIRE geometric C and D. Pullback of a target g thus gives g(rho(beta))<=g(rho(nu))/K. This uses the normal-centre theorem, not analytic irreducibility of nonnormal R.

Let d=nu(ell)=nu(c0)>0. Choose integers L>d and B>0 with 1+B(1-d/L)>K. Set b=B+1, I=(ell)+a^L and F=(B/L)v(I)-(B+1)v(a). I is actual proper primary: ell vanishes on another component and cannot be a unit. On V_a, F is continuous in[-b,-1], equals-1 on component1 and at the common fibre, and at rho(nu) is-1-B(1-d/L)<-K. It is a signed REAL Cartier evaluation on a common primary blowup. Therefore EVERY geometric minorant g<=F has g(rho(beta))<=F(rho(nu))/K<-1.

For every n put T_n=a^(bn)+(j)a^n and q_n=-v(T_n)/n. These are actual proper primary ideals, whose negative effective REAL Cartier divisors on ACTUAL blowups are relatively ample and positive on EVERY contracted integral curve. On component1, q_n=max(-b,-1-v(j)/n); on every other component it is-b. Thus q_n<=F on EVERY support. At every component1 point with finite j-value, sup_n q_n=-1. This locus is dense in the full component1 boundary: G331's divisorial density gives a dense set of generic-support centred divisorial valuations, where j is nonzero and has finite value. Alpha belongs to its closure, although it kills the conductor.

A greatest C/D minorant would dominate all q_n and equal-1 on that dense locus because F=-1 there. Its normalization pullback is USC. A value<-1 at alpha would have a strict sublevel neighbourhood meeting this locus, a contradiction. But alpha and beta have the same target point, where EVERY minorant is strictly below-1 by the preceding inequality. Hence neither greatest minorant exists. Dense nets suffice; no metrizability or sequence extraction is assumed.

An algebraic sufficient condition is that distinct minimal primes p1,p2 have dim R/(p1+p2)>=1. The excellent positive-dimensional reduced quotient has a nonempty centred boundary by G331. A semivaluation there factors through both R/p_i and lifts through their finite normalizations to two different minimal-domain factors over the same target point. The conductor value must be infinite by finite-stratum uniqueness. Thus EVERY positive-dimensional intersection of distinct irreducible components obstructs universal continuous envelopes, in ANY dimension, characteristic or residue field, already for a signed primary-model obstacle.

Nonsingleton fibres confined to one minimal-domain normalization are not covered. General excellent normal dimension>=3 CE is not decided. No source CE, new ideal cone, resolution, arbitrary-model cofinality, norm averaging or deleted support is used. All profiles are homogeneous and exact primary-gauge transport preserves the conclusion. Artifacts: n3.md and n3.tex. Rerun: python deliver.py; python check_delivery.py. This is a universal draft proof relative to qualified G331, not original-task closure.
